working_definition: T4c is one of the four directional subtypes (a-d) of T4 neurons in the Drosophila optic lobe. It is a columnar, ON-pathway, direction-selective neuron whose dendrites arborise in medulla layer M10 and whose axon terminals project specifically to lobula plate layer c (layer 3). T4c encodes upward visual motion and is cholinergic.

best_match.fbbt_definition: T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 3 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in an upwards direction (Henning et al., 2022).

justification: FBbt:00003734 'T4c neuron' is defined as the T4 subtype with its lobula plate arbor in layer 3 that responds to upward motion (Fischbach and Dittrich 1989; Henning et al. 2022). The atlas cluster 'T4c' is defined identically: a T4 (ON-pathway) columnar optic lobe neuron whose axon terminals target lobula plate layer c (layer 3) and which encodes upward visual motion. The label, layer specificity, and directional tuning all match precisely. The FBbt term is not obsolete and is a direct subtype of T4 neuron (FBbt:00003731). The GEO README correction (T4c/T4d labels previously swapped) does not affect the mapping -- the label T4c as corrected aligns with the layer-3 upward-motion identity captured by FBbt:00003734.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T neuron with its cell body posterior to the lobula plate and a cell body fiber that projects through the lobula plate and via the second optic chiasma, with little or no arborization, to medulla layer 10 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Shinomiya et al., 2019). It forms a fine arborization in medulla layers M9 and M10 and its axon then doubles back across the second optic chiasma to form bleb-type arborizations in a single layer of the lobula plate (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Shinomiya et al., 2019). It is a cholinergic neuron (Mauss et al., 2014; Shinomiya et al., 2014). There are a large number of these cells, which are generated from neuroblasts that amplify by symmetric division (type III) before generating the T4 (and T5) neurons (Mora et al., 2018).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent term covering all four T4 subtypes (a-d); the cluster 'T4c' is specifically the layer-3, upward-motion subtype. Using the parent would be a broad match and would lose the defining layer identity that is central to this cluster's annotation.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T4c neuron (Hormann et al., 2020). Early during its development, it projects its axon to lobula plate layer 3 (Hormann et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Developmental precursor term. The Kurmangaliyev 2020 atlas captures adult or late-pupal neurons; this term describes an immature precursor and is not appropriate for an adult scRNAseq cluster.

recommendation: Map cluster T4c to FBbt:00003734 (T4c neuron) with skos:exactMatch. The label, lobula plate layer-3 targeting, and upward-motion direction-selectivity all correspond precisely. No new FBbt term is needed.
